versions.changelog: Installs @priors/mcp 0.8.5: the key from a file (PRIORS_KEY_FILE), daily limits per agent and wallet, a pay_url host allowlist, and the daily and session caps counting money in flight (GHSA-266h, GHSA-24qq). All new limits are off by default.
Installs @priors/mcp 0.7.2 with @priors/x402 0.6.2: an aborted x402 call signs nothing more (GHSA-868j).
Installs @priors/mcp 0.7.1: an x402 offer whose payment flow the client cannot sign is refused before anything is borrowed.
Installs @priors/mcp 0.7.0: an agent can also pay x402 sellers that take USDC on Base, from a small USDC float on Base, when its owner turns it on (off by default).
Installs @priors/mcp 0.6.4: a PT trade whose answer from the node was lost stays counted against the session cap, and the answer says it may have been sent.
Installs @priors/mcp 0.6.3: a money call still running keeps counting against the session caps, so a later call cannot pass them beside it.
Installs @priors/mcp 0.6.2: every money call answers within its budget, and a money call made while another still runs does nothing and says so.
First release, for OpenClaw and Hermes Agent: check an agent's repayment record before paying or trusting it, and pay, borrow and repay in USDG on Robinhood Chain with the Priors MCP tools.
